name: Eventene
description_en:
Eventene currently positions itself as recurring programme coordination software. It connects participants, activities, schedules, responses, assignments, messages and attendance across repeated cycles such as training cohorts, certification, onboarding or chapter programmes. Its value proposition is reusing the operating structure while updating the people and details that change.

This is a more specific identity than a generic event ticket shop, and the website explicitly distinguishes it from an LMS. It coordinates programme logistics rather than establishing content-authoring, examinations or learning-record capabilities. The public annual offer is scoped to a primary programme family and participant allowance.
description_zh:
Eventene 目前定位为重复项目协调软件，把参与者、活动、日程、回答、任务分配、消息和出勤连接到培训批次、认证周期、入职或分会项目等重复流程，复用运行结构并更新每轮变化的人员及细节。

这一身份比通用活动售票更具体，官网还明确区分 LMS。它协调项目运营，不能据此证明具有教学内容创作、考试或学习记录能力。公开年度方案限定主要项目家族及参与者额度。

core_features.explanation_en: Copy activities, questions and attendance settings, then connect current participants.
core_features.explanation_zh: 复制活动、问题和出勤设置，再关联本轮人员。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect schedules, assignments, instructions, responses and check-in in programme context.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在项目上下文中关联日程、分配、说明、回答及签到。

en: Coordinate a quarterly training cohort with reusable sessions and current assignments.
zh: 使用可复用场次与当期分配协调季度培训。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Define one programme family, import current participants, reuse a cycle and inspect a changed assignment through attendance.
steps.zh: 定义项目家族、导入当期人员、复用一轮，并核对分配变化直到出勤。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Annual programme package with participant allowance and optional app/consulting/analytics.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual Platform from $9,500/year: unlimited cycles, one primary programme family, up to 1,500 participants. Branded app, consulting and advanced analytics are premium add-ons. Currency and exact participant/admin metering require quote confirmation; no free production plan was verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Annual Platform 年费起价 $9,500，含不限周期、一个主要项目家族、最多 1,500 人。品牌应用、咨询和高级分析为附加项。币种与人数/管理员计量需报价确认，未核实免费生产方案。

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Reuse structure without copying stale participant state
sections.title_zh: 复用结构时避免沿用过期人员状态
sections.en: The website describes copying activities, questions, attendance settings and configuration into another cycle, then connecting the appropriate participant groups. For an illustrative quarterly training cohort, reuse the session structure but refresh dates, facilitators and enrolment. Check a cancellation against roster, capacity, instructions and attendance so that reuse does not preserve an obsolete assignment. This is proposed acceptance work, not a tested workflow.
sections.zh: 官网介绍复制活动、问题、出勤设置和配置到下一轮，再关联适当人员组。例如季度培训可复用场次结构，但要更新日期、讲师和报名。取消时应核对名单、容量、说明和出勤，避免复用保留过期分配。这是建议验收，不是已执行流程。

sections.title_zh: 核对参与者的个性化信息
sections.en: Eventene connects registrations and responses with schedules, locations, assignments and messages, then records attendance. The intended operating model is one programme context for coordinators and participants. Verify what a particular participant sees after a schedule or group change; an updated coordinator view does not prove every message or mobile view refreshed. No offline behavior, notification delivery or integration API was verified.
sections.zh: Eventene 把报名和回答关联到日程、位置、分配和消息，再记录出勤，让协调者与参与者围绕同一项目操作。应核对分组或日程改变后某位参与者实际看到什么，后台更新不能证明消息或移动视图全部刷新。离线行为、通知送达及集成 API 均未核实。

sections.title_en: Scope the annual programme family and participants
sections.title_zh: 定义年度项目家族与人数范围
sections.en: The annual platform starts at $9,500/year and lists unlimited programme cycles, one primary programme family and up to 1,500 participants. It includes standard operational reporting and account support. Separate premium add-ons cover a branded app build, configuration/import/training consulting and advanced analytics. Do not interpret unlimited cycles as unlimited programme families, participant capacity or custom services. Ask how unique participants, repeat attendance and administrators are counted.
sections.zh: 年度平台起价 $9,500，包含不限周期、一个主要项目家族、最多 1,500 位参与者及标准运营报表和支持。独立高级附加项包括品牌应用构建、配置/导入/培训咨询和高级分析。不限周期不代表项目家族、人数或定制服务不限，需确认独立人数、重复出席和管理员如何计量。

sections.title_en: Shortlist for repeatable operations, not assumed learning features
sections.title_zh: 按重复运营需求选型，不推定教学能力
sections.en: Recurring cohorts and geographically repeated programmes are plausible fit cases; a single public ticketed event or a full LMS replacement requires separate investigation. Public pages contain placeholder testimonial and FAQ content, which is not customer evidence. The product is presented as a hosted platform; source license, self-hosting, refund terms, storage region and failure recovery were not verified. A scoped demo should walk through the next actual cycle, including an exception.
sections.zh: 重复批次及跨地区复用项目是合理场景，单次公开售票活动或完整替代 LMS 则需另查。公开页含占位证言和 FAQ，不能当客户证据。产品以托管平台呈现，源码许可、自托管、退款、存储地区和失败恢复未核实。范围明确的演示应走下一轮真实项目，并包含异常。

research_gaps: No cycle reuse, import, personalized mobile view, notification, check-in or reporting was tested.
Placeholder website content cannot establish customer evidence; participant metering, add-on prices, license, self-hosting, recovery and retention require confirmation.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
